chosen.title: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift: The Best Exercise for Strength & Longevity
chosen.description:
Most people ignore the Single-Leg Deadlift.
 
That’s a huge mistake.

This unilateral strength exercise is one of the best movements for bulletproofing your knees, fixing imbalances, and building functional strength and athleticism.

Whether you're training for longevity, sports performance, or injury prevention, the SLDL needs to be in your program.

Here’s what you’ll learn in this video:

✅ Why the SLDL is essential for strength & longevity

✅ How to progress from wall assisted to full SLDL✅ The 2 most common mistakes & how to fix them

✅ Simple ways to add this to your training routine

Try the progressions & let me know how it feels! Drop a comment below if this helped.
